headline: Bread Worker Food
title: Bread | Best Homeland worker food | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Hungry workers stop producing in your Aniimo Homeland, so feed them well. Energy Bites give only one thousand energy. Wheatmeal gives nine thousand three hundred seventy. Bread gives twenty six thousand seven hundred forty. Cook Bread in the Claw Game Cooker from two Wheatmeal and five Well Water. Then put it in the Food tab so workers draw from it. What do you feed your workers? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Put it in the Food tab

description: Aniimo Homeland food guide: Bread restores 26,740 energy versus 9,370 for Wheatmeal and 1,000 for Energy Bites. Recipe is 2 Wheatmeal and 5 Well Water at the Claw Game Cooker.
